text: I miss the option of negative tasks – for example, smoking cigarettes. If I don't smoke, nothing happens, but if I smoke, the app makes me lose 30 coins. I'd love to see this added in future updates. Other than that, it's a great app.
author: Adrian Tomczak

text: I like it and imho it's much better than other apps that offer nothing really useful, but annoying habits suggestions, mood trackers etc. On the other hand if this app included some motivational quotes and a space for journal/notes and a to-do list, then it would deserve 100 stars.

text: Good and simple app, but it misses one feature. You should have option to modify past history of habits. For example I forgot to check some activity last night, and i can't change that today. This bothers me. That upgrade will change my opinion for 5 stars.
author: Agnieszka „Ori”
developer_reply: Hello, thank you for your love of funhabit. Maybe "backlog" is the function you need. You can find it in the "mine" interface.
